digest.component_or_area: LLM provider integration — OpenAI Responses API readiness
propositions: Pydantic-ai 1.107.2 can construct OpenAIResponsesModel for hosted OpenAI endpoints, but rebar's config, provider resolution, and capability mapping lack support for the openai-responses: prefix, blocking runtime usage

Four rebar code sites (KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES, _pydantic_ai_known_providers, _PROFILE_RESOLVERS, openai:→openai-chat: normalizers) must be updated to enable openai-responses: routing and structured-output capability detection
Third-party OpenAI-compatible endpoints (Groq, xAI, DeepSeek, etc.) remain Chat-Completions-only under the pinned pydantic-ai version; no Responses construction path exists for those providers

Contract tests at tests/unit/test_openai_responses_contract.py parameterize structured-output, streaming, tool-call, retry, and custom-base-URL assertions identically over openai-chat: and openai-responses: prefixes to establish behavioural equivalence at the wire protocol level
